reason: The verse says the One rose as caste differences (சாதிபேதம்) among its many forms, a metaphysical claim; the finding dates the onset of endogamy, which shares the topic of caste but does not test the verse's claim.
The stanza places the five letters (அஞ்செழுத்து) in the breath-horse (வாசி பரி) but says nothing about breathing rate or the heart; shared topic of breath only.
The verse is about renouncing women (பெண்சாரல் நீக்கி) and gaining siddhi without the body ceasing; it says nothing about loving-kindness or compassion practice.
A letter-mantra stanza about the snake, the breath (வாசி) and the five senses; nothing to do with curcumin or any remedy.
The verse says there are not two gods (உண்மை இரண்டு இல்லையே), a claim about sectarian division; Bell nonlocality has no bearing on it.
The 21,600 measures of paddy (நெல்) are read as the daily breath count only through cipher; the Tamil never names breath, so the link to slow-breathing HRV is topical at most.
The verse says the inner instruments and five senses (கரணம், புலனைந்து) become one and steady; it makes no claim about perceiving the heartbeat.

The verse claims a milk that grows in the skull (தலை மண்டையில் வளரும் பால்) lets one live on (நாளும் இருந்திட); reading it as inner nectar is cipher, and the finding on breath stock and lifespan shares only the longevity topic.

The verse claims the root fire's heat is kindled by the breath (மூலஅங்கி தணல் எழுப்பி வாயுவால்); the finding that tummo and breathing practice can raise body temperature bears on a breath-generated heat, though the root fire and nectar are yogic terms.
The verse praises a Siva-yogi whose silence is not opening the mouth in rage (வாய்திறந்து சீறாத மோனம்); it makes no claim the default-mode finding speaks to.

The verse claims that in nishtai the 'he' and 'I' fall away (தான் நான் என அற்று) while the body persists; the speculative finding that self-loss in deep meditation is reported in distinct forms bears on the first claim without settling it.
A lament for the dying of anger, speech, 'I' and mind (மனமாண்டு, நான்மாண்டு) before release; nothing on sleep or brain clearance.
The verse tells the inner demon not to wander (நீ அலையாதே) and to seek nothing; this is advice for stillness, not a claim that wandering makes one unhappy, so the overlap is topical.
Questions on the five-letter mantra and its chanting (செபிப்பது); the verse claims nothing about breathing rate or baroreflex, so only the topic of recitation is shared.
The stanza defines service, yoga as bindu-nada (விந்துநாதம்) and a Sadasiva state; it makes no claim about evidence or research quality.
Praise of the guru as a rain-cloud of bliss (ஆனந்த மழைமேகம்); nothing about silent word repetition.

The verse claims that daily meditation on the five letters with ash makes the unstable gross body stable (தூலசடம் நிலைக்கும்), a kaya-siddhi claim; the cortical deactivation finding shares the mantra topic but not the bodily claim.

The verse names the body a cage of death and a ship of ceaseless disease (மரணப் பஞ்சரம், ஓயா நோய்க்கிடம்) as a moral rhetoric of disgust; ageing hallmarks share the topic of bodily decay without testing a specific claim.
நாடி here means the three yogic channels at the mooladhara (மூன்று நாடி), not the pulse; the shared word is incidental to pulse-diagnosis reliability.
சோதி is the Full One as light, a theological epithet, not a reported perception in meditation; the shared idea of 'light' is incidental.
The verse directs the mind (மனம்) to the uvula and sushumna (சுழுனை); it names no breath or nostril, so alternate-nostril breathing and blood pressure do not bear on it.
The moon hidden by cloud (சந்திரனை மேகம் மறைத்த) is a simile for bondage hiding the Fullness; nothing about circadian clocks.
A letter-mantra verse (வவ்வெழுத்து, மவ்வெழுத்து, சிவ்வெழுத்து) about the syllables folding into 'a'; it shares the topic of mantra but claims nothing about breathing or baroreflex.
The verse urges joining the mind to its object steadily like a magnet and iron (காந்தம் வலி இரும்பு); it shares the meditation topic but makes no claim about anxiety, depression or pain.

The verse says those who promise alchemical silver and gold (வாதம்செய்வேன், பொன்) take the money and run, i.e. the promise is a fraud; the finding that gold cannot be made by alchemical processing supports the falsity of the promise, though the verse itself is about the trick, not chemistry.
Desire for women is called a dream (அடைகனவு) to be ended; the wanting-liking finding shares the topic of desire but the verse makes no claim about craving outgrowing pleasure.
A begging vow accepting that the body may waste (ஏகம் இளைத்தாலும்); the verse claims no benefit from hunger, so fasting and autophagy share only the topic.
The verse promises kaya-siddhi and maya-siddhi (காயசித்தி, மாயசித்தி) within two years; reading மாயசித்தி as psychic powers is a gloss, so psi replication failure is a topical link only.
A proverb of the snake in the anthill and worldly bond in the heart (பாம்பிருக்குது புற்றுக்குள்ளே); nothing about microtubules or quantum consciousness.
An exposition of the tvam-pada and its adjuncts (தொம்பதம், உபாதி); unrelated to gut microbiota.
The body as an earthen puppet that falls when the hidden mover stops (தேகம் விழும்); no claim about voluntary control of temperature or immunity.
A confession of not knowing maya and not seeing oneself (என்னையுங் காணேனே); Orch-OR has no bearing on it.
The verse says there is no medicine to keep dying humans from dying (மாயாமல் வைக்க மருந்தில்லையே); continual cell renewal shares the body topic but does not bear on that claim.

reason: The verse tells the inner demon not to wander (நீ அலையாதே); linking this to reduced default-mode activity needs a generous mind-wandering reading, so it is topical only.

The verse asks whether gold (சொர்னம்) grows when mercury and sulphur (சூதம், கெந்தி) are heated in a crucible by those ignorant of the art, implying it does not; the finding that mercury becomes gold only by nuclear reaction, never chemical processing, is direct evidence for that, though it also rules out the 'right' alchemy the verse leaves open.

The verse calls the tale of joining lead with gold (வங்கமுக்தங்கஞ் சேர்த்திருக்கதை) a disgrace while alchemists melt லிங்கம்; the finding that gold cannot be made chemically supports the debunking, though the cinnabar sense of லிங்கம் is a technical gloss.

The verse claims the world (ஞாலம்) is imagination produced by the inner faculties (அந்தக்கரணங்களாலே விளைந்த), an idealist ontology; predictive processing concerns perception as inference, so the match needs a generous reading.
A colophon telling வாசிமுனி that drugs and salts were told truthfully and silence will follow; வாசி is only the disciple's name, and nothing concerns recitation or breathing.

The body is called a dwelling where worms come to stay (புழுவந்துறையிடமே) and prey for kites; the microbial-body finding shares the idea of other organisms in the body, but the verse describes the corpse in disgust, not a claim about bacteria.
The verse claims knowing the state of the breath (வாசி நிலை) accomplishes tapas; it says nothing about breathing rate or heart-rate variability, so the overlap is the breath topic.
